notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{U}
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
